delete.description: Delete your account and all your data. Type DELETE to confirm; this can't be undone.

get.description: Download everything stored about you (JSON files + your resume files).

post.description: Upload a PDF or DOCX. Parsing runs in the background; poll GET /resumes/{id}.

put.description: Save the user's edits. Bumps profile_version, which invalidates cached match scores.

get.description: Saved preferences, or suggested defaults (titles from the active resume).
Every job source, whether its key is configured, and whether it's paused.

post.description: Start a job or internship search with the saved preferences. 409 if one is running.

get.description: How many AI requests scoring your unscored jobs would take, and how many are left.

post.description: Score this job again against your current resume (uses one AI request).
Find a contact and write an email + cover letter in the background; poll the result.
Save for later (an application in "saved", with no drafts yet).

get.description: Every application as a board card (the client groups them by `column`).
Today's emails: your daily limit, sent, waiting in the queue, and how many are left.

patch.description: Edit the email, cover letter, contact or notes. The fast fact checks re-run on save.

post.description: Write a new version of one draft (kept alongside the old ones).
Run the AI fact-check again (after editing).
Confirm that flagged claims are accurate (needed before copying or marking applied).
Drag and drop on the board: change column (status) and/or order.
Write a short follow-up email (you send it yourself; poll the application).
You sent a follow-up: counts it and schedules the next reminder (two at most).

Schedule the reviewed email to go from your Gmail in 30-120 s (cancellable until then).

Needs `preview_confirmed: true` (set by the final preview) and an `Idempotency-Key`
header; a retried request with the same key returns the same result.
Stop a scheduled email before it goes (it returns to Ready).

get.description:
Returns Google's consent URL; the browser goes there, then back to the callback.

Gmail with `read=true` also asks for read-only access, for reply detection.

post.description: Rewrite the tracker sheet now (it also updates itself a few minutes after changes).

put.description: Turn reply detection on or off. Turning it on needs read access (connect with read=true).

post.description: Look for replies now (it also runs every 15 minutes).

get.description: Latest notifications (follow-up reminders are created here when they're due).
Stat cards, funnel, top missing skills and weekly activity.
Your AI requests this month, by feature and model, and today's free requests left.

MatchSummary.title: MatchSummary
MatchSummary.description: What a job card shows about the match.

PayStatus.title: PayStatus
PayStatus.description: Whether a posting (mostly relevant for internships) pays, from salary or wording.

ScoreEstimate.title: ScoreEstimate
ScoreEstimate.description: How many AI requests scoring the user's unscored jobs would take right now.
